g.text: NTC divider behavior: open thermistor -> ADC near 3.3 V; short -> ADC near 0 V. Firmware treats both as faults and uses the hottest valid reading.

g.desc: NTC divider behavior: open thermistor -> ADC near 3.3 V; short -> ADC near 0 V. Firmware treats both as faults and uses the hottest valid reading.
